metadata.description: lib_log_rich delivered as a single Claude Code plugin: a skill to install, configure, deploy and operate lib_log_rich, the multi-sink structured logging library for Python.

plugins.name: lib_log_rich
plugins.description: Install, configure, deploy and operate lib_log_rich: RuntimeConfig and its LOG_* environment overrides, console, journald, Windows Event Log and Graylog sinks, systemd/container/Windows deployment, scrubbing, the stdlib bridge, queues and subprocesses, validate_config, ring-buffer dumps and the CLI.
